name: RenderAsyncSlotsInit
description: renderer init: copies per-slot configs, applies the vendor rules to the async-slot table 44C04D0 (non-NVIDIA: slot 0 off; NVIDIA driver <= 0x1C92: all off), builds the slot mask, copies the table to 45C0460, calls AsyncSlotsCreate 32FA450 on mgr+0x1130

name: RenderAsyncSlotsInit_VendorGate
description: non-NVIDIA branch into the slot-0 disable loop 226A499; AS experiment patches the je (226A497 74 -> EB)

name: RenderAsyncSlotsInit_NvOldDriverGate
description: NVIDIA and driver <= 0x1C92 -> every slot enable = 0

name: g_AsyncSlotTable
signature: struct{u8 enable; f32 param; u32 slotId}[13]
description: static async-compute slot table; shipped enables slots 0,3,4,6 (slot 6 param 0.5); read once at renderer init

name: g_AsyncSlotTableLive
signature: struct{u8 enable; f32 param; u32 slotId}[13]
description: runtime copy after the vendor rules (BSS, zero before init); PC dump: slots 3,4,6

name: AsyncSlotsCreate
description: for each set mask bit: AsyncComputeCtxCreate; stores mask at s+0x1CC; slot 0 also starts the KIDS job KIDS_ASync_LLCulling_Effect (cb 3D16AC)

name: AsyncSlotGetCtx
description: returns the async compute context of a slot if (s+0x1CC mask bit set and s+0x17C[slot] >= 0), else NULL (caller then records into the graphics stream with tokens 7C/7D)

name: AsyncSlotAddFence
signature: void(AsyncSched* s, key, u32 slot, u64 fence)
description: appends a context fence handle (ctxIndex<<56 | value) to the slot's pending list s+0xE0[idx]; the graphics side waits on it

name: AsyncComputeCtxCreate
description: allocates a free async context slot d+0x74D8[i] (count d+0x3E28) and initialises it via 2EF8354

name: AsyncComputeCtxInit
description: AsyncComputeCtxCreateQueue on ctx+0x68; optional own dispatcher backend (vtable 409A3B0) when cfg+0x3D

name: AsyncComputeCtxCreateQueue
description: CreateCommandQueue(type 2 COMPUTE), N compute allocators + lists, event, compute root signature, CBV/SRV/UAV/sampler heaps

name: GfxCreateDirectQueue
description: CreateCommandQueue(type 0 DIRECT) + allocator + fence + list (the device's GFX queue path)

name: GfxCreateCopyQueue8
description: CreateCommandQueue(type 3 COPY) + 8 copy lists

name: GfxCreateCopyQueueB
description: CreateCommandQueue(type 3 COPY); falls back to the GFX queue (dev+0x4270) on failure

name: GfxCreateCopyQueueC
description: CreateCommandQueue(type 3 COPY) + N copy lists

name: KtglAsyncBackend_vtbl
description: async/deferred context backend: +10 Begin, +18 GetFence (KTGL tok 1), +38 End, +48 IsFenceDone 4F9368, +50 CpuWaitFence 2EF9820, +60 tok 7 2EF9088, +68 tok 6 3D1B5C, +D0 Dispatch

name: KtglCtxGetFence
signature: u64*(KtglContext* c, u64* out, u32 flag)
description: out = (c+0x10 ctx index << 56) | backend->GetFence(flag)

name: EclEmitWait
description: writes ECL token 8 {queue, fence, value} (queue->Wait on the ECL thread)

name: SynTokComputeBegin
description: KTGL tok 0x7C: compute section begins on the graphics list (c+0x541 = 1, dirty 0x40)

name: SynTokComputeEnd
description: KTGL tok 0x7D: UAV barrier (1139D4), dirty 0x20, c+0x541 = 0

name: SynTokFencePoint
description: KTGL tok 1 handler body: list boundary + fence on the dispatcher context (list ring c+0x5A0)

name: OffScreenRenderSubmit
description: OffScreenRendering pass; KtglCmdStreamFlush(ctx, 1) at 253EE0 (explicit submit site)

name: KtglWaitQueryOrKick
description: if a GPU query/fence handle is not ready: KtglCmdStreamFlush(ctx, 1) at 3D2CDF so the GPU gets the work

name: DrawSubmit_K1Kick
description: K1 kick with submit = 0 (all 29 K1 kick sites pass 0); design E2 would make it B2 01

name: CmdStreamEndFrame_StatsSnapshot
description: copies the per-frame stream stats +3C78..+3CFF to +3D00: +3D00 draws, +3D04 kicks, +3D10 ring-full wait timer, +3D28 drain-spin timer

name: KtglTimerAccumulate
description: acc[0] += now - t0, acc[1] = max, acc[2]++ (QPC or clock())

name: KtglContext::DispatchRingCap
description: dispatcher ring capacity (write +3C04, read +3C08, in flight +3C10, semaphore +3BF0, items +3BF8)

name: KtglContext::LastFrameStreamStats
description: previous frame: draws, kicks; +0x10 ring-full wait timer; +0x28 drain-spin timer

name: AsyncSched::SlotMask
description: async slot mask (sched = mgr+0x1130)
